# artifact media type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:artifactMediaType`](gmeow-artifactMediaType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/artifactMediaType>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/attestation`](../../slices/attestation.md)
- **Box roles:** [CBox role](../boxes/cbox.md), [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The media type of the attestation artifact's serialization (e.g. application/vnd.in-toto+json, application/vc+ld+json).

## Structure

**Property shape:** datatype property; [`gmeow:AttestationArtifact`](../classes/gmeow-AttestationArtifact.md) -> [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:artifactMediaType`](gmeow-artifactMediaType.md) from [`gmeow:AttestationArtifact`](../classes/gmeow-AttestationArtifact.md) to [`rdfs:Literal`](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#Literal) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record the IANA media type of an attestation artifact's serialization, so a consumer can dispatch the right parser before re-verifying it.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for the broad attestation kind ([`gmeow:attestationType`](gmeow-attestationType.md), e.g. SLSA provenance) — the media type is the wire format string, not the attestation category — and avoid two values, since it is functional.

### How to use

- Set one media-type literal on the [`gmeow:AttestationArtifact`](../classes/gmeow-AttestationArtifact.md); pair it with [`gmeow:attestationType`](gmeow-attestationType.md) on the [`Attestation`](../classes/gmeow-Attestation.md) so consumers know both the format and the kind.

### Examples

- ex:inTotoJson [`gmeow:artifactMediaType`](gmeow-artifactMediaType.md) "application/vnd.in-toto+json".
